user.title: ABRP Telemetry - Credentials
user.description:
Configure the connection to A Better Route Planner.

Get your Telemetry API key here:
https://abetterrouteplanner.com/home/app/api-keys/telemetry

You also need a user token from the ABRP app.

data_description.api_key: From ABRP Telemetry API Keys page
data_description.user_token: From ABRP app: Settings → Car → Generic → Show Token
data_description.update_interval: Recommended: 5 seconds. ABRP uses this for accurate predictions.

entities_basic.title: ABRP Telemetry - Basic Sensors
entities_basic.description:
Map your vehicle sensors to ABRP data fields.

**High Priority:** SOC is required. Position, Speed, Power and Charging are highly recommended for accurate route planning.

data_description.soc_entity: Battery level in % (as shown on dashboard). This is the primary value for route planning.
data_description.speed_entity: Vehicle speed in km/h. Used for consumption calculations.
data_description.position_entity: GPS location. Required for route tracking and charging station proximity.
data_description.power_entity: Current power in kW. Positive = output (driving), Negative = input (charging).
data_description.charging_entity: Whether the vehicle is currently charging (on/off or binary sensor).
data_description.range_entity: Vehicle's estimated remaining range in km.

entities_advanced.title: ABRP Telemetry - Advanced Sensors
entities_advanced.description:
Additional sensors for more accurate predictions.

These are optional - skip if not available.

data_description.soh_entity: Battery health in %. 100% = no degradation. Only if your vehicle reports this.
data_description.current_entity: Battery current in A. Positive = output, Negative = charging.
data_description.batt_temp_entity: Battery temperature in °C. Important for charging speed predictions.
data_description.ext_temp_entity: Outside temperature in °C. Affects range and HVAC consumption.

fixed_values.title: ABRP Telemetry - Fixed Values
fixed_values.description:
Enter fixed values for parameters that your vehicle doesn't report via sensors.

⚠️ **These values are constants** - only use if your vehicle doesn't provide a sensor for these.

Leave at 0 to skip.

data_description.soh_fixed: Battery health in % (100 = no degradation). Measure with ABRP calibration drives or OBD tools. Set to 0 to use sensor instead.
data_description.capacity_fixed: Usable battery capacity in kWh. Usually slightly less than advertised (e.g., 62 kWh usable from 66.5 kWh total). Set to 0 to skip.
